scenes.title: Benny's Morning
scenes.text: Benny the rabbit wakes up under the big oak tree. A silver bell rings across the forest. A note on his door says: the Forest Crystal is gone. Grandma Rabbit lives close by. She always knows what to do. Under his bed is a little wooden box. Benny takes a deep breath. Today he will be brave.

scenes.title: Grandma's Advice
scenes.text: Grandma Rabbit gives Benny a warm hug. "Brave does not mean you are never scared," she says. "Brave means you help anyway." She points out of the window at the dark forest path. "The old Wise Tree knows many things." On her wall hangs a big green shield.

choice_labels.Shield: 🛡️ Shield — Ask for the green shield

scenes.title: The Little Box
scenes.text: Benny finds a small wooden box under his bed. The lock is shaped like a golden star. Something inside goes clink.

scenes.title: The Golden Key
scenes.text: The box opens with a soft click. Inside is a shiny Golden Key. A little note says: this key opens the tower door.

scenes.title: The Leaf Shield
scenes.text: Grandma gives Benny a shield made from one giant leaf. It is light as a feather and very strong. "This will help you cross the river," she says. "Now go into the forest. And ask the Wise Tree which way to go."

scenes.title: The Whispering Forest
scenes.text: Benny walks into the forest. Blue butterflies glow all around him. Then he hears someone crying. A little squirrel is stuck in a thorn bush.

scenes.title: Sammy the Squirrel
scenes.text: Benny talks softly and pulls the squirrel free. "Thank you!" says Sammy the squirrel. He gives Benny a big red apple. "A hungry friend may need this," he says. "Now go over the old bridge. Or ask the Wise Tree first."

choice_labels.Run: 🏃 Run — Go to the broken bridge

scenes.title: Careful Paws
scenes.text: Benny uses his wooden sword to push the thorns apart. He is very careful and very slow. Sammy the squirrel hops out, safe. He gives Benny a big red apple to say thank you. "The old bridge is that way," he says.

choice_labels.Run: 🏃 Run — Go to the broken bridge

scenes.title: A Quiet Mistake
scenes.text: Benny hides behind a mushroom and waits. The crying stops. The forest feels colder now. He walks on towards the old bridge. But his heart feels heavy. He could still go back.

choice_labels.Run: 🏃 Run — Keep walking to the bridge

scenes.title: The Wise Tree
scenes.text: The oldest tree opens one sleepy eye. "The crystal is in the mountain tower," it says. "Cross the old bridge to get there. But every path asks for kindness first." Near its roots, blue mushrooms glow in a circle.

choice_labels.Run: 🏃 Run — Follow the path to the bridge

scenes.title: The Mushroom Circle
scenes.text: Blue mushrooms hum a soft song. Benny sees a picture in their light. A lonely fox carried the crystal up to the old tower. She was not stealing it. She wanted its light to help her sick sister. The path to the old bridge glows too.

choice_labels.Talk: 💬 Talk — Go and meet the fox

scenes.title: The Broken Bridge
scenes.text: Benny reaches a fast river. The old bridge is broken in the middle. The tower waits on the other side. A big strong shield could help him cross. Deep in the water, a turtle called Tilly is sleeping.

choice_labels.Shield: 🛡️ Shield — Cross with the leaf shield

scenes.title: Across the Bridge
scenes.text: Benny holds the leaf shield over his head. The wind lifts it like a sail. He floats safely to the other side. In the mud he sees fresh fox tracks. Below him, Tilly the turtle waves hello.

scenes.title: Tilly the Turtle
scenes.text: A big turtle rises out of the water. "Small feet can still go far," she says. Tilly carries Benny across on her shell. "A fox came this way," she says. "Listen. The river is singing a song."

scenes.title: The Long Riverbank
scenes.text: Benny walks along the river. This way is longer and darker. Then he sees fox footprints in the mud.

choice_labels.Talk: 💬 Talk — Walk up to the fox

scenes.title: The River Song
scenes.text: Benny sits very still and listens to the river. He learns its quiet song. Now the plants of the forest will listen to him. Even the old vines on the tower. The fox tracks lead that way.

choice_labels.Run: 🏃 Run — Follow the fox to the tower

scenes.title: The Fox's Shadow
scenes.text: Benny hides behind a rock and watches. A fox looks up at the tower window. The Forest Crystal glows high inside it. Her paws are shaking. She looks scared, not mean.

scenes.title: The Wrong Kind of Brave
scenes.text: Benny waves his wooden sword and shouts. The fox runs away, frightened. Benny feels bad right away. Scaring someone is not the same as helping. Up on the hill he can see the tower.

choice_labels.Talk: 💬 Talk — Say sorry to the fox

scenes.title: Fina the Fox
scenes.text: Benny walks up slowly and says hello. The fox is called Fina. "My little sister is sick," she says. "I hid the crystal up in the tower. I hoped its light would make her well." The forest needs the crystal. But Fina needs help too.

choice_labels.Key: 🗝️ Key — Head for the tower door
choice_labels.Talk: 💬 Talk — Make a promise to Fina
choice_labels.Magic: ✨ Magic — Give your apple to her sister

scenes.title: The Apple Gift
scenes.text: Benny gives the big red apple to Fina's little sister. She eats every bite and smiles. "Thank you," says Fina. "Now I will help you get the crystal back." The tower waits up on the hill.

scenes.title: A Promise Under the Stars
scenes.text: Benny makes a promise to Fina. Together they will ask the Wise Tree to help her sister. Fina wipes her eyes and smiles. Far up in the tower, the crystal glows a little brighter.

choice_labels.Open Door: 🚪 Open Door — Try the tower gate

scenes.title: The Mountain Tower
scenes.text: An old stone tower stands on the hill. Green vines cover the walls. The crystal shines behind a locked door. Benny needs a key. Or he needs the vines to lift him up. Far below, the river shines in the sun.

choice_labels.Magic: ✨ Magic — Ask the vines for help
choice_labels.Run: 🏃 Run — Go back to the river

scenes.title: The Door Will Not Open
scenes.text: Benny pushes the heavy door. It does not move at all. A golden keyhole blinks like a sleepy star. High above him, the vines rustle softly.

choice_labels.Magic: ✨ Magic — Ask the vines to lift you
choice_labels.Run: 🏃 Run — Step back and look around

scenes.title: The Helpful Vines
scenes.text: Benny hums the quiet river song. The vines wake up and listen. They lift him gently to a round window. The golden door is still far below him.

choice_labels.Open Door: 🚪 Open Door — Climb in the window

scenes.title: The Golden Door
scenes.text: The Golden Key fits the lock. Benny turns it very slowly. The door opens with a happy little song. Inside is a round room. The crystal is glowing on a stone.

choice_labels.Open Door: 🚪 Open Door — Go into the crystal room
choice_labels.Talk: 💬 Talk — Call out to the crystal

scenes.title: The Crystal Room
scenes.text: The Forest Crystal sits on a stone. Its light is very weak. Benny can take it home right now. Or he can think about Fina and her sister first. What kind of hero will he be?

choice_labels.Magic: ✨ Magic — Help the forest and Fina

scenes.title: Golden Ending
scenes.text: Benny brings the crystal home. Then he helps Fina's little sister get well. The forest turns green again. The river sings. Every animal cheers for Benny. He was brave and kind.

scenes.title: Silver Ending
scenes.text: Benny brings the crystal home. The stars shine bright again. All the animals are safe. Far away, Fina watches and waits. She still hopes someone will help her too.

scenes.title: Soft Ending
scenes.text: Benny runs home before he decides. He is safe in bed by sunrise. But he still thinks about the little fox. Next time, he will stay and help.
